findings.motion: M11 Concur, HB 589 VIVA/Election Reform (House roll call 1337, passed 73 to 41)
findings.note: House vote to concur with the Senate changes to HB 589, the Voter Information Verification Act and election reform bill, which became S.L. 2013-381. Davis is on the aye list.

findings.motion: Listed among the non-primary sponsors of HB 589, VIVA/Election Reform
findings.note: The bill page lists Davis among the sponsors (non-primary) of HB 589, VIVA/Election Reform, Ch. SL 2013-381. The page does not give the date he signed on.

findings.motion: Second Reading, HB 958 Election Law Changes (House roll call 758, passed 66 to 47)
findings.note: House second-reading vote on HB 958, Election Law Changes. The seventh edition of the bill text includes a requirement that voter registration applications state citizenship, removal of deceased persons from voter lists, and a process to remove voters flagged as potential non-citizens from a federal database. Davis is on the aye list.
